summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on PR #416, then perform comprehensive documentation updates including pruning stale deferred items, updating feature matrices, refreshing the README, and creating a new filesystem specification document.
summary.outcome: All 4 PR review threads resolved and pushed; documentation branch created with thorough updates to DEFERRED.md, FEATURES.md, README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL.md, FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md (new), and CLAUDE.md; phases 38 and 39 added to roadmap; PR #419 created.

repo: Grafana Faro (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) is the implemented observability/error tracking solution — not Sentry or Datadog as older docs suggested
Desktop FUSE layer has no unit tests by design — it is thin OS plumbing and is covered by the Desktop E2E suite instead
Vault v1 legacy columns were removed when staging was reset; the current baseline migration (1700000000000-FullSchema.ts) does not include them

@cipherbox/crypto has a devDependency on @cipherbox/core solely for a single test file (vault-ipns.test.ts) that verifies key separation — this was meant to be cleaned up after the Phase 19 restructuring
Large files (video and audio) use AES-256-CTR encryption client-side; small files use AES-256-GCM — the filesystem spec incorrectly stated uploads always use GCM
Linux FUSE uses the same 'fuse' feature flag as macOS: NFC normalization, case-sensitive lookups, libfuse3 backend
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is an operator-level env var, not a user-facing setting — the user-configurable bin retention is still a deferred feature
The database has grown to 14 tables including share_invites and pin_migrations added in later phases; DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL.md was significantly out of date
TEE provider is Phala Cloud CVM, not AWS Nitro (which was previously listed as a planned fallback)
IPNS republish interval is 6h, not 3h as documented in CLAUDE.md
The old 00-Preliminary-R&D/ documentation path was renamed to .planning/milestones/m0/ during a reorganization

code.finding: postMessage/getWorker calls can throw, leaking pending map entries — fixed with try/catch that deletes the pending entry on error
uploadFiles() doc comment overstated memory bounding — corrected to accurately describe chunked streaming behavior

Only file importing @cipherbox/core inside the crypto package — a devDependency that creates an unintended circular dependency; should be refactored to use hardcoded test vectors or moved to an integration test directory
Linux FUSE is fully implemented using libfuse3, same NFC normalization and case-sensitivity as macOS

workflow: When asked to audit a list for stale items, verify every single item against the codebase rather than spot-checking only the ones explicitly called out by the user
GraphQL resolve threads can be batched in a single mutation call
Use --field (not -f) for integer parameters like in_reply_to when posting PR review replies via gh api
Integration tests that require a live backend will fail in CI/local without a running service — treat these as expected pre-existing failures when assessing test suite health
Operator env vars and user-facing settings are distinct concepts — do not conflate them when reviewing deferred items
Session replay is an anti-feature in a zero-knowledge privacy product and should never be added to the roadmap

friction: Initial deferred items audit was too shallow — required multiple rounds of user corrections to remove already-implemented or out-of-scope items (Grafana Faro, session replay, vault v1 columns, Linux FUSE, log shipping, batch pin events, per-file IPNS, DTS circular dep, useFileOperations decomposition)

FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md had several factual errors introduced at creation: missing Linux platform, audio omitted from AES-CTR description, incorrect claim that all uploads use AES-GCM — required multiple follow-up edits
Git commit hook required lowercase subject line — initial commit with parenthetical subject failed and needed a retry
Edit tool reformatted markdown table widths after an edit, obscuring surrounding content and requiring re-read before subsequent edits
open_items: Phase 38: Retire folder.service.ts (1,059 lines, 9 importers) and bin.service.ts (971 lines) by migrating callers to SDK methods; also remove @cipherbox/core devDependency from crypto package by refactoring vault-ipns.test.ts to use hardcoded test vectors
Phase 39: User-configurable vault parameters — bin retention period (default 30 days), soft vs hard delete toggle, max versions per file, version cooldown period
Lazy file reading in useDropUpload.ts / batch upload pipeline — requires changing SDK contract to accept File objects or a read callback instead of Uint8Array (architectural change, deferred)
Sharing: per-share revocation, share expiry dates, share activity audit log
Search: full-text search across file names and metadata
Observability: distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) across API and FUSE layer
Upload pipeline: resumable uploads for large files, parallel chunk verification
Security: formal third-party security audit before public launch
